column1: # Laptop jobs the watch follows (probes/watch.sh, 10 Oct 2026). Add a row when a job is launched, delete it when its outcome is recorded.
# TAB-separated: name, log (relative to the plan folder), marker ERE (lines reported once; lines containing 'armed' are skipped), end ERE (the job's
# last marker), process ERE (matched in `ps -ef`; bracket the first letter so the pattern never matches itself).
